rationale: Price sits at 98.8% of today's range, essentially at the intraday high of $25.02, after the most recent 5-minute candle printed ~9x the volume of the prior four candles on a push from $24.80 to $25.02 — a pattern consistent with climax/exhaustion rather than orderly breakout continuation. While sentiment is strongly positive and relative volume confirms institutional interest, the reward/risk for a long entry here is asymmetric to the downside (only $0.02 to resistance, $0.20+ to meaningful support at the prior consolidation zone), and there is insufficient evidence of committed follow-through sellers to justify a short against the tape in a rising SPY session.
